questions.stem: What type of genetic diagram can be used to show the inheritance of sex in humans?

options.text: A pie chart of male and female ratios
A Punnett square using X and Y chromosomes

questions.explanation: A Punnett square using the sex chromosomes (XX for the mother and XY for the father) shows that there is a 50:50 chance of producing male (XY) or female (XX) offspring.
